column1: This is a short summary of clients of this function:

are removed from the packet path before the filter is released. Thus

column2: the ppp_lock ensures serialization between the

column1: xmit and filter attachment/detachment path. This doesn't use rcu
so deferred release via rcu makes no sense.

the isdn_ppp_ioctl(). This driver uses mutex and spinlocks
Thus
column2: deferred rcu makes no sense to me either

column1: may be just masking the effects of wrong locking strategy

column2: this is the only place where the rcu

column1: synchronization with unattached filter is used. Therefore
patch introduces synchronize_rcu() which is called from the
genetlink path to make sure the filter doesn't go away while packets

add some specific struct rcu_head in the scope of the team driver if
